GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Eased early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (5L from lead). Held Ground 3 Wide No Cover midrace until improving slowly from 500m & Five Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Six Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & held ground in last 200m. # Wide/held ground.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 2nd last 6 Lengths 800m 2nd last 3 Wide 7 Lengths home turn Four Wide 6th widest runner Straight ran on final 200m # back/wide/ready
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m was steadied when tightened for room. Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on well without threatening # no match 1,2
Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then waited for the cutaway, railed to Lead 160m and kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 800m was steadied when racing in restricted room. Held up on heels for a short distance on straightening.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and bumped a runner. Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. got up fence turn 1 length. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 4 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground to 3 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 250m was checked  and carrried out across heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , worked hard Wide and got Outside Leader .5 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along soon after Straightening Up and weakened last 200m # on pace/tired 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Raced three wide, without cover, in the early stages before working forward to settle outside the leader near the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3rd trailing 3 Lengths 3 Wide , Moved Up to trail 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered to centre of track Straightening Up , kept trying but no match for the winner in Straight # winner far too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , kept chasing winner in Straight and whilst holding down its 2nd place gave up another length to the winner # winner far too good
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.75 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by 700m, held together much same to turn 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , steered centre of track and kept trying in Straight # battled on fairly
